name: container-management
title: Native container management: read-only API and simulation
description: Phase 1: native read-only container APIs, dual-UI flat editor, isolated simulation and regression checks.
creator: tom
notes: Phase 1 continues in Draft PR #30. Direct container-IP access replaces port mappings. Network/startup advanced toggles, inline runtime Files browsing, row trash icons and plain-language health checks are implemented. The isolated full dual-UI test service on port 8080 passed authentication, real snapshot/Files, startup preservation, health inheritance/override projection, write denial and embedded-asset checks. Upload/mkdir and container mutations remain simulation-only. Awaiting full-panel visual acceptance/root review; real writes and production acceptance remain deferred.
